questions.question: A new operator has two reports for Lyra-EN-01. First: a steady amber glow after load transfer. Second: a double copper mark while room pressure rises. Explain the fault and the permitted next step without jargon.
questions.expected_answer: The cause is thermal rebound. Keep the auxiliary vent closed.

questions.question: Someone must act on Lyra-EN-02. The unit itself produced a steady amber glow after load transfer; the room independently produced a black ring while room pressure is stable. Give one complete answer.
questions.expected_answer: The cause is thermal rebound. Use remote controls only.
